pitfalls: Weight storage does not set the GPU compute precision: request GpuOptions(precision = FP32). At the default precision the outputs stay finite but one of 70 span sets changes (card 'Measured quality and performance', s128 row 69/70, max confidence drift 3.3e-2).

The graph is the dense prefix of the upstream BoundaryExtractor (mDeBERTa-v3-base encoder, boundary encoder, boundary query head, per-token projections): the host looks up the word-embedding rows before the graph (host_assets/word_embeddings_fp16.bin [250112,768] float16, rows upcast to float32; fp32 table as reference) and runs the upstream gliner2 sparse decoder after it (host_assets/runtime/, 16 decoder tensors); the five inputs are args_0..args_4 = inputs_embeds [1,128,768], attention_mask [1,128], text_routing [1,48,128], query_routing [1,5,128], text_mask [1,48]; one packed float32 output [1,1,1,78110] with 17 logical slices (graph_contract_s128.json).

The caller selects the word splitter per request — official whitespace for space-delimited text such as English, official char for Japanese / CJK; there is no language detector, and capacity counts processed text slots and encoded tokens (text ending in 。 takes one extra slot). Fixed window N=128 / T=48: longer inputs are rejected, not truncated (card 'Files and supported configuration', HOST_CONTRACT.md).

Two fp32-exact rewrites are inside the shipped graph (attention-mask fill -10000 instead of the float32 minimum; each of the 29 active LayerNorms computed on x*2^-3 with eps*2^-6; 60/60 bit-identical comparisons with the stock graph) so the same files stay finite under fp16 delegates — finite, not exact: the Galaxy S26 Hexagon NPU (JIT) matched 69/70, 72/75 and 77/80 span sets with every difference a 0.5-threshold near-tie (max confidence drift 4.8e-2), so the card reports the NPU and does not offer it as a supported path (card 'Measured quality and performance').

Back-to-back requests heat the phone: the s256 and s512 GPU jobs rose from thermal status 0 to 1-2 and their sustained medians (93.0 / 422.5 ms) are 1.5-2.1x the cool opening values (63.5 / 200.9 ms); the card states both with their condition. Latency is a single-device sample (card 'Measured quality and performance').

Validated only for the five fixed labels in that order, threshold 0.5, English (whitespace) and Japanese (char), one window per call, on the Galaxy S26 (card 'Limits'); conversion fidelity to the official gliner2 fp32 implementation (span F1 1.000 on 80 bilingual inputs), not a general accuracy claim — upstream misses carry over (4 of 10 expected organizations on ten early Japanese sentences).
